resources.string: A compass from your phone\'s sensors. No location needed.
This phone has no magnetometer, so it can\'t show a compass.
Low accuracy: move the phone in a figure 8, away from metal and magnets.
The top of your phone points northeast (45°). North is 45° to your left. Magnetic north; keep it away from magnets and metal.

Points to magnetic north, worked out on this phone with no internet. True north is a few degrees off, depending on where you are; it would need your location, which BOAR doesn\'t ask for. Hold the phone flat. You can also ask in the chat which way is north.
